note_en: 用 A 代替 B means "replace B with A" (literally "use A to take the place of B"): 他用西式的摆盘代替了传统大盆上菜的方式 "he replaced the traditional big platters with Western-style plating." Watch the order: Chinese names the new thing first, after 用, and the old thing after 代替, while English "replace B with A" mentions the old thing first.
